executiveSummary: Major trends in tech news include the rise of AI and its applications, significant hardware releases, and industry shifts towards sustainability and personalization. Apple's foldable iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro set to become default models, while Meta's Muse AI agent aims to catch up in the AI race. Meanwhile, Sony's disc production and Apple's 140W USB-C Power Adapter firmware update also made headlines.

takeaways.title: AI and ML developments
takeaways.description: Meta's Muse AI agent and ChatGPT Images 2.5 demonstrate the growing importance of AI in technology, citing specific articles (9to5Mac, The Verge).
